risks.proof: A video of the bike being cycled through all gears while the rear wheel is elevated.

risks.risk: The disc brakes may be noisy, contaminated, or have worn pads.
risks.proof: A video of the bike braking to a stop and a close-up of the brake calipers.
risks.if_unproven: as requiring new brake pads and rotor cleaning.

risks.risk: The front suspension fork may be seized or leaking.
risks.proof: A video showing the fork compressing and rebounding under weight.

risks.risk: The chain and cassette may be excessively worn.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the rear cassette teeth and the chain links.
risks.if_unproven: as needing a new chain and cassette.
